policies.title: Belizean ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism route includes Belize, requires online application, and sends the tourism visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Use the standard regular Belizean citizen ePassport, not a temporary, medical-emergency, diplomatic, official, special, refugee or other travel document. Appendix I of Nigeria Immigration Service's current service-level agreement directly lists paid Belizean single-entry, multiple-entry, TWP and STR visa fees. Together with the F5A all-country rule, this establishes that Belize is not among the visa-waiver exceptions.
Apply online with the Belizean citizen passport and F5A tourism documents. The visa is single entry, valid for 90 days from issuance, and permits a stay of up to 30 days.
The emailed visa certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance. Work, residence, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa application
steps: Apply online with the Belizean citizen passport and stated tourism documents.
Pay and receive the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the certificate and supporting documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Belizean ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's Government-authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email as a PDF before travel.
conditions: The current service asset says all nationalities can apply for an eVisa. Use the same standard regular Belizean citizen ePassport for application and travel; it states that only a regular passport is accepted and other travel documents are not eligible.

Apply online through the Government-authenticated eVisa service. The current service asset says the eVisa is sent by email and available as a PDF download before travel; this is electronic issuance, not an arrival-issued visa.
The ordinary visitor route does not establish work, residence, diplomatic, official, temporary, emergency, special, refugee, carrier or final-admission entitlement.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea official eVisa service
steps: Apply online using the Belizean citizen ePassport for travel.
Receive and retain the emailed PDF eVisa before departure.
Present the same passport and eVisa at arrival for immigration processing and final admission.
